ipa.curves._bond_curves.curves.Definition

Generates the Bond curves for the definitions provided.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._bond_curves.curves.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    *,
    constituents: OptCreditConstituents = None,
    curve_definition: CurveDefinition = None,
    curve_parameters: CurveParameters = None,
    curve_tag: OptStr = None,
    outputs: OptStrStrs = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
constituents OptCreditConstituents No None CreditConstituents object.
curve_definition CurveDefinition No None CreditCurveDefinition object.
curve_parameters CurveParameters No None CreditCurveParameters object.
curve_tag OptStr No None A user-defined string to identify the interest rate curve. it can be used to link output results to the curve definition. limited to 40 characters. only alphabetic, numeric and '- _.#=@' characters are supported.
outputs OptStrStrs No None
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters.

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None Callable function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

Example

from lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._bond_curves import curves
definition = curves.Definition(
    curve_definition=curves.CreditCurveDefinition(
        reference_entity="0#EUGOVPBMK=R",
        reference_entity_type=curves.ReferenceEntityType.CHAIN_RIC
    ))
response = definition.get_data()

# Using get_data_async

import asyncio
task = definition.get_data_async()
response = asyncio.run(task)
